pictures.name: Fernhollow
pictures.prompt: Redraw this game map as an isometric view: 16-bit pixel art in the style of Stardew Valley, the same place seen from above at an angle. Keep its layout: every building, wall, path, fence, water and open ground where the map has it, the same size and shape, in the same places relative to each other. Add nothing the map does not show. What is on it: Fernhollow, A human village of thatched cottages, gardens, low stone walls and a mill on a stream, where open fields meet the edge of a great forest. In it: The village green: A grassy common with an old oak and a well, where the market is held; The Antlers inn: A thatched inn with a sign of a stag's antlers, warm, smoky and loud; Mother Wenna's cottage: A crooked cottage at the forest's very edge, its garden thick with herbs; The mill: A stone watermill on the stream, its wheel turning slowly. Marked on the map: old oak, well, herb garden, mill wheel. The ground: green countryside. Full-bleed scene, atmospheric light. No writing of any kind: no labels, names, captions, arrows or signs, and no border.
